fact: Sudan Horizon reports the Finance Ministry signed an SMS agreement with Zain to support Eisali, the state electronic collection and payment system, notifying users of transaction status.
The Sudan Ministry of Finance statement says MTN SIM users can use the state-owned electronic collection and payment system Eesaly and track the transactions they complete through it.
The Ministry of Finance report says the electronic payment and collection system (Esali) was expanded in the first half of 2026.

Al Arabiya reports that disruption of the Bankak banking app of Bank of Khartoum reaches government transactions and electronic collection, and that payment and collection channels tied to taxes, customs and public fees could be disrupted.

Kafuta said government institutions in RSF-held areas were told to open Future Bank accounts and stop collecting official payments through Bankak, depositing revenue in cash or transferring it through Future Bank's application.
Zakher's Recurring Debit Order service is offered for collecting government fees and fines by automatic deduction from the customer's wallet, per Zakhir Wallet.
Sudanhorizon says Eisali is a unified electronic payment system launched by the Ministry of Finance for digital collection of government service fees.
The Sudanese Standards and Metrology Organization, with the Ministry of Finance, launched a pilot of paying standards certification fees through the Eisali-Baladna integration in Khartoum.
Sudan's finance ministry says its Isali electronic collection and payment system has been in use since early 2024, with contracts signed with 22 banks.
Sudan's finance ministry says Isali is relied on to collect all public revenue fees approved in the state budget, and is integrated with the ASYCUDA customs system.
